notes: Batch 30 RECONCILED CLOSURE 2026-09-29. Full narrative and the corrected 25-row Manual UX table in docs/journey-runs/BATCH_30_RESULTS.md. Executed strictly batch-by-batch: Batch 31 has NOT been started and must not begin until the user reviews this reconciled closure. No implementation code was changed (only docs/TECH_DEBT.md, docs/NEXUS_JOURNEY_UNIVERSE.md's Z-025 count correction and Z-030 canonical rewrite, plus this bookkeeping). Reversible test actions taken and fully restored: Reference Master 'Mid Market' segment deactivated then reactivated (X-003); real USD currency rate changed 91 -> 99.5 -> 91 (X-005); several disposable Storage objects created and deleted (Z-021, Z-027, twice). One unrestorable residue disclosed: a single inert, superseded (is_current=false) go_live_documents metadata row on the real aurora-consumer-labs customer, created in error during Z-027's redo attempt and immediately reverted to non-current; its underlying storage object was deleted; the row itself is immutable by design and cannot be removed, but it carries no business meaning and does not affect the customer's visible document state. Key process notes: (1) 'environment rendering friction' must not be accepted as a permanent tooling limitation for an ordinarily-testable Manual/Mixed journey without first attempting real recovery (fresh tab, taller viewport); only genuine, durable capability gaps (no file-picker access, no safe clock skew, no safe fault injection, no real commit-order instrumentation) qualify as PARTIAL / TOOLING LIMITATION. (2) RPC-only or source-only evidence must not be presented as a live UX confirmation; if the real Server Action/browser path cannot be reached, the journey is PARTIAL, not PASS, even when the underlying code is confirmed safe. (3) A canonical requiring a specific real duration (e.g. Z-027's 300 seconds) must be tested at that literal duration, not a shorter proxy, when the resources exist to do so; a shorter proxy is acceptable evidence only when the real duration genuinely cannot be tested. (4) Journey Discovery findings that only require a documentation correction (not a code change or a Product Decision) must be reconciled in the same pass, not deferred to 'a future pass.' (5) Do not mutate real, shared, live customer records to manufacture UX evidence; use only self-created disposable objects/fixtures, exactly as already established in this program, and stop immediately if a safety classifier flags an action as an unauthorized shared-state mutation. Do not start Batch 31 until the user reviews this reconciled closure.
